symptoms: Narrow, rectangular tan to gray lesions strictly bounded by leaf veins
Lesions merge to blight entire leaves under high disease pressure
Premature stalk lodging and reduced grain fill
risk_factors: Continuous corn cultivation with heavy surface crop residue
Warm, humid weather (24-30°C) with persistent fog or dew
prevention: Plant resistant corn hybrids with high GLS disease ratings
Rotate fields out of corn for at least 1-2 seasons
Tillage to bury infected corn residue where soil conservation allows
recommended_actions: Apply foliar strobilurin or triazole fungicides between VT (tasseling) and R2 stage
